$comment: A port that vcpkg INSTALLED and that vcpkg.json never names -- which is exactly the shape of
issue I-02: brotli, bzip2, liblzma and libiconv all arrive this way. This one is GPL-3.0-only
so the closure enumeration has something it must refuse.
Before the Inventory.cpp change this file was invisible to the gate: loadManifest built its
list from vcpkg.json's dependencies and features arrays plus the non-vcpkg overrides, and
never enumerated what vcpkg actually installs.
